en.headline: MTR to offer half-fare travel on Thank You Day this Saturday
en.dek: Passengers using Octopus, JoyYou Card or QR codes on most of the network, including East Rail Line border crossings, will pay half fare on 24 October.
body: The MTR Corporation said half-fare travel will be available on Saturday 24 October under its Thank You Day arrangement.

Passengers using an Octopus card or JoyYou Card on the MTR, Light Rail and MTR Bus routes in the Northwest New Territories, or QR-code tickets on the heavy rail network, will receive the discount. Cross-boundary journeys on the East Rail Line to and from Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau are included.

The half fare can be combined with interchange discounts, Fare Saver offers, the 25 percent discount on connecting journeys with a Monthly Pass, and the government $2 Scheme. It does not apply to East Rail Line first-class charges, the Airport Express, MTR Feeder Buses, the High Speed Rail Hong Kong section, or journeys paid with single-journey tickets or contactless cards.
The operator said additional staff would be deployed at stations and that train services would be adjusted if necessary. Notices and broadcasts are already in place at stations.

zh.headline: 港鐵本周六感謝日提供半價乘車
zh.dek: 乘客使用八達通、樂悠咗或二維碼乘搭大部分網絡，包括東鐵綫過境車程，24日可享半價車費。
body: 港鐵公司表示，本周六（10月24日）將舉行感謝日，提供半價乘車優惠。
當日乘客使用八達通或樂悠咗乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及行走新界西北的港鐵巴士，或以二維碼乘搭重鐵網絡車程，均可享半價。東鐵綫來往羅湖及落馬洲站的過境車程亦包括在內。
半價可與轉乘優惠、特惠站、全月通連接車程七五折優惠，以及政府二元優惠計劃同時使用。優惠不包括東鐵綫頭等額外費、機場快綫、港鐵接駁巴士、高速鐵路香港段，以及以單程票或感應式卡付費的車程。
港鐵表示會在車站加派人手，並視乎情況調整列車服務。車站已張貼告示及作出廣播，乘客亦可透過手機應用程式及網頁查閱詳情。
